name: Get It Together, Drops!
summary: Lets dropped item entities merge with others over a larger area, which reduces lag from piles of loose items such as explosion craters or farm outputs. Works server-side; players need nothing installed.

mechanics.title: Merge radius
mechanics.description: Config 'radius' (0.5 to 500) is how far an item searches for others to merge with; 0.5 is vanilla.

mechanics.title: Vertical check
mechanics.description: Config 'checkY' makes items also look above and below; false is vanilla.

mechanics.title: Item tags
mechanics.description: getittogetherdrops:do_not_combine stops listed items from merging; getittogetherdrops:ignored makes listed items use vanilla behavior and takes precedence.

vanilla_changes.change: Dropped items can merge across a configurable radius rather than the vanilla 0.5 blocks.

editor_notes: The pack's configured radius/checkY values were not found in config-overrides; defaults assumed vanilla-equivalent unless the config says otherwise (verify).
